summary: iter118r profile photo fix verified. Backend guard on POST /api/trainee-profiles and POST /api/trainer-profiles correctly rejects device-local URIs (file://, content://, ph://, assets-library://) with HTTP 400 and the expected detail message. Valid data:image/png;base64,... uploads persist correctly and sync end-to-end across the profile endpoint, GET /api/{role}-profiles/{userId}, and GET /api/auth/me (profilePhoto for trainee; both profilePhoto and avatarUrl for trainer). Also verified all 5 frontend files now import from 'expo-file-system/legacy' as required.

rca of the issue: expo-file-system v19 deprecated top-level readAsStringAsync. In 5 pickImage code paths the throw was silently caught and the raw file:// URI was persisted as profilePhoto, so avatars never rendered. Fix: (1) all 5 frontend files now import from 'expo-file-system/legacy', (2) backend adds defense-in-depth guard rejecting file://, content://, ph://, assets-library:// prefixes on both profile POST endpoints — verified with parametrized tests.
